exercises.title: Add a category and get its new id back
exercises.problemHtml:
CT Shop starts selling backpacks. Create the category Balo & túi as a child of Dụng cụ học tập (category id 3) and, in the SAME statement, get back the row PostgreSQL stored: its id, name and parent_id.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • One INSERT into category that does NOT write the id — the identity column assigns it.
  • End it with RETURNING id, name, parent_id.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.title: Three new books in one statement
exercises.problemHtml:
Three books arrive for the Giáo trình IT category (id 12). Insert all three with ONE statement:

sku      name                       price    stock
CT1207   Lập trình Python cơ bản    99000    40
CT1208   Git cho nhóm               69000    25
CT1209   Linux & Bash               85000    (not counted yet)

The Linux book's stock is not counted yet: let the column's DEFAULT decide. Return id, sku, stock of the three new rows.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • Exactly ONE INSERT statement with three rows after VALUES.
  • Write DEFAULT (not a number) for the Linux book's stock.
  • Finish with RETURNING id, sku, stock.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.title: Count tag hits with ON CONFLICT
exercises.problemHtml:
Each time a reader opens a tag page the app records one hit. Write the ONE statement that records a hit for tags sql and date: an existing tag gets hits + 1, a new tag starts at 1. Return tag, hits.

tag_stat (tag text PK, hits int DEFAULT 0) — ('sql', 3), ('ops', 1)

Requirements

  • INSERT … VALUES ('sql', 1), ('date', 1) ON CONFLICT (tag) DO UPDATE SET hits = tag_stat.hits + 1.
  • RETURNING tag, hits.

INSERT INTO tag_stat (tag, hits)
VALUES ('sql', 1), ('date', 1)
ON CONFLICT (tag) DO UPDATE
   SET hits = tag_stat.hits + 1          -- existing counter: +1 (not "= 1")
RETURNING tag, hits;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A counter upsert is the classic ON CONFLICT pattern: one atomic statement, safe even when two readers hit the same tag at the same moment (the second waits for the first row lock, then adds its own +1).

exercises.title: Receive a delivery with UPSERT
exercises.problemHtml:
A delivery truck brings:

sku      name                               category_id   price    qty delivered
CT0501   Bút bi Thiên Long TL-027 (xanh)    5              5000    100
CT0604   Tẩy Pentel Hi-Polymer              6              9000     50
CT0505   Bút gel Zebra Sarasa Clip 0.5mm    5             24000     60

Products already in the catalogue (same sku) must get the delivered quantity added to their current stock — their name and price stay as they are. Unknown SKUs become new products with that stock. Do it in ONE statement and return sku, stock of every row touched.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • One INSERT … ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE statement.
  • Existing rows: stock = old stock + delivered qty; do not touch price or name.
  • Finish with RETURNING sku, stock.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: For each row PostgreSQL tries the INSERT; when the UNIQUE index on sku already holds that value it runs the DO UPDATE branch instead, on the existing row. EXCLUDED is the proposed row, p the stored one. RETURNING reports both inserted and updated rows.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Với từng dòng PostgreSQL thử INSERT; khi chỉ mục UNIQUE trên sku đã có giá trị đó thì chạy nhánh DO UPDATE trên dòng cũ. EXCLUDED là dòng định chèn, p là dòng đang lưu. RETURNING báo cả dòng chèn mới lẫn dòng được cập nhật.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

glossaryJson.giaiThich: INSERT … ON CONFLICT (khoá) DO UPDATE / DO NOTHING: trùng khoá thì sửa dòng cũ hoặc bỏ qua, trong MỘT lệnh nguyên tử.
Trong ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, EXCLUDED là dòng bạn định chèn mà bị trùng khoá.
INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE … RETURNING cột ⇒ lệnh ghi trả lại các dòng nó vừa đụng tới — khỏi phải SELECT lại.
